theorem.actual_control_contradiction: In every actual R82 pairing deck, each positive C5 target has an empty inverse. Such a base-field predicate DAG cannot be an exact membership or source locator on those controls.
theorem.base_field_polynomial_identity: For f in F_p[X], f(z^(-1))=f(z^p)=f(z)^p. Hence f(z)=0 if and only if f(z^(-1))=0.
theorem.base_field_rational_identity: The numerator-zero and denominator-zero outcomes of every univariate F_p rational predicate are inversion invariant on the subgroup.
theorem.decision_dag_consequence: A deterministic DAG branching only on zero or definedness outcomes of univariate base-field polynomial or rational predicates follows the same path on z and z^(-1).
not_covered: tests that consume nonzero predicate values
general arithmetic-circuit or data-structure lower bounds
theorem.order_two_frobenius: For z in the order-q subgroup and characteristic p=-1 mod q, z^p=z^(-1).
scope_limits: univariate target polynomials with coefficients in F_p
univariate base-field rational zero and definedness tests
deterministic DAGs using only those Boolean outcomes
theorem.uniform_random_subset_comparator: For a uniformly random M-subset S of an odd prime-order group, E|S intersect S^(-1)|=M^2/q. At M=B^(15/4+o(1)), q=B^(5+o(1)), this is B^(5/2+o(1)), an o(1) fraction B^(-5/4+o(1)) of S.
